serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: New Relic is the intelligent observability platform, providing complete visibility across your complex IT environment (both on-prem and in the cloud). Our SaaS solution is a unified data platform that ingests and analyzes a wide array of telemetry data—metrics, events, logs, and traces. This provides a single source of truth for monitoring the performance of applications, infrastructure, and user experiences. Our platform empowers your teams to see, understand, and act on real-time telemetry data from every application, service, and piece of infrastructure.
